verdict.rationale: Extend accepts scanned and photographed inputs (PDF, PNG, JPG, TIFF) and advertises Agentic OCR, handwriting detection, and accuracy on the "hardest documents." One long-term customer reports being happy with extraction accuracy. However, nothing in the evidence specifically addresses the hard cases the story names. Missing for 10: documented handling of skewed or rotated pages, stamps or seals, and low-quality or noisy scans; independent OCR accuracy benchmarks or hands-on tests on degraded scans.
